title: Remove “Make This App Live” section and publish-help page

requirements.text: Remove the “Make This App Live” entry point from the Landing Page, including its click handler and any related imports/icons, so the Landing Page no longer shows publishing/help CTA UI.

quotes: remove the make this app live section its not needed

acceptanceCriteria: LandingPage no longer renders a button labeled “Make This App Live”.
The navigate handler that routes to /publish-help is removed from LandingPage.
LandingPage builds with no unused-import lint/type errors after removing Rocket icon usage.

requirements.text: Remove the “Make This App Live” entry point from the authenticated UI (user profile dropdown), including its click handler and any related imports/icons, so users cannot navigate to publish-help from inside the app.

quotes: remove the make this app live section its not needed

acceptanceCriteria: UserProfile dropdown no longer contains a menu item labeled “Make This App Live”.
The navigate handler that routes to /publish-help is removed from UserProfile.
UserProfile builds with no unused-import lint/type errors after removing Rocket icon usage.

requirements.text: Remove the dedicated publish help route and page from the app so /publish-help is no longer part of the TanStack Router route tree and the PublishHelpPage is not shipped.

quotes: remove the make this app live section its not needed

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/App.tsx no longer imports PublishHelpPage and no longer registers a route with path /publish-help.
PublishHelpPage is removed (or otherwise not reachable/compiled) and there are no broken imports.
Navigating to /publish-help no longer resolves to an in-app help page (route is absent).

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui (compose only).
Do not add new backend services or databases; backend remains a single Motoko actor.
nonGoals: Do not implement any new publishing/go-live functionality or alternative publish flow.
Do not redesign unrelated Landing Page or dashboard features beyond removing the “Make This App Live” section/links.
Do not modify backend Motoko code for this change.
